{{Top|leg}}
The '''Belasco Free Volunteers''' was a military organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]].

During that era, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] colonies on the frontier of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] suffered routine attacks from [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-affiliated [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. The Free Volunteers were involved in the successful defense against an [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|assault]] on the world of [[Parcovey Minor]], one of the few bright spots in the Hutt attacks on the colonies. They were subsequently involved in a counterattack against [[Affavan]], where they took revenge against the [[Utoradii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] that had ordered the raid.
